reading.passage: Last month I felt very upset because I had a big fight with my best friend, Lily. Although we had been close for years, I said some hurtful words to her on purpose, and she stopped talking to me. For days I felt lonely and full of anger. I did not say sorry until my mother advised me to put myself in Lily's shoes. So that I could clear the air, I wrote her a long letter to apologize. I told her how thankful I was for our friendship. Although I was nervous, I gave it to her the next morning. She read it and smiled. Now we are close again, and I feel relaxed and joyful. I learned that we must control our anger so that we do not hurt the people we love.
reading.passageCn: 上个月我很难过，因为我和我最好的朋友莉莉大吵了一架。虽然我们多年来一直很亲密，但我故意对她说了一些伤人的话，她便不再和我说话了。有好几天我感到孤独，满心怒火。直到妈妈劝我设身处地为莉莉着想，我才道歉。为了尽释前嫌，我给她写了一封长信道歉。我告诉她我多么感激我们的友谊。虽然我很紧张，但第二天早上我还是把信给了她。她读完后笑了。现在我们又亲密如初，我感到放松又快乐。我明白了，我们必须控制怒火，以免伤害我们所爱的人。

writing.topic: How I Dealt With a Bad Feeling
writing.prompt: Write a short passage about a time you felt upset, lonely or under pressure. Explain what happened and how you dealt with the feeling. Use although, until and so that at least once each.
writing.promptCn: 写一篇短文，讲述你曾经感到难过、孤独或有压力的一次经历。说明发生了什么，以及你是如何应对这种情绪的。请至少各用一次 although、until 和 so that。
writing.opener: Last week, I felt really upset because

cards.hint: 如 I felt upset and lonely because...
如 I talked to my mother so that I could feel better
如 Although it was hard, I felt relaxed in the end

l1: Last week, I felt very upset because I had a problem with my friend.
Although I wanted to talk to her, I was too shy.
I felt lonely until my mother gave me good advice.
I learned to control my anger so that I would not say hurtful words.
l2: At first I was full of anger and could not calm down.
Although the pressure was great, I tried to look on the bright side.
I did not feel better until I took a few deep breaths.
I wrote my friend a letter so that we could clear the air.
l3: Although I was nervous, I decided to forgive my friend.
I waited until she was ready to talk to me again.
I spoke to her kindly so that she would understand my feelings.
Now I feel relaxed and thankful, and we are close friends again.
